name: Button
purpose: The one general action button for chrome, footers, bulk grid, section headers, trash strip, toasts, filter panel, reset, lightbox, capture-bar wells and the rich-text link button. Merges A's ToolbarButton and IconButton action uses with B's Button (B's consolidation, with A's exact sizes, radii and tones kept where they are visible). Folds in IconButton: Icon-only form becomes Button size=icon (the icon and shape form). Surface, shape, tone and reveal axes become Button variant or props (B). Do not move pressed or pressedIcon, since aria-pressed belongs to Toggle, nor haspopup or expanded, since aria-haspopup belongs to MenuButton and aria-expanded to DisclosureButton (A). Button's purpose (index.txt line 4) already says it merges IconButton, but IconButton is still listed at index.txt line 26 and in widgets.json, so remove the separate entry. Folds in DashedButton: variant=dashed (shadcn ships dashed as a variant). Its size and width axes become Button size and width props. The measured 35px and 84px heights are kept as exact size values, not folded to 63px or 28px (A, medium confidence). Index line 15 keeps it apart only for its own job, which is a variant, not a component. Job (add-something action in an empty slot) and role (button) match. Folds in TextButton: variant=link with no fill at rest (B, index line 75), with tone, size and hover variants. Truncate, mono, block and done become Button props. Conflict: A names this variant=text. B's variant=link is kept because it cites index line 75 precisely; the team should confirm the name. Both are role=button and trigger an action or open something inline. Folds in TileButton: layout=stacked (icon above label in an equal-size tile). Both proposals agree on the value. Confidence is medium (A) and lower (B), since the index says a stacked layout is not a size of Button, so the team should confirm. As a layout variant the job (entry action) and role (button) are unchanged.
base: shadcn/ui Button (cva), Radix Slot for asChild

props.name: variant
props.description: Fill and border look. Filled variants own the fill; tone owns text colour.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and label scale. See size axis.

props.name: tone
props.description: Text and icon colour for ghost and outline. Ignored by filled variants.

props.name: shape
props.description: Icon-only square or label with icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Typed Material Symbols name. Glyph size follows size and shape (see size axis).

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Trailing glyph, for example the chevron on MenuButton.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text. Required when shape is text.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name. Required when shape is icon or the label is not descriptive.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Accelerator shown in the tooltip only, mapped per platform (Command on macOS, Control on Windows and web). Display only; the binding lives elsewhere. Used by Clear draft and Attach screenshot.

props.name: busy
props.description: Replaces the icon with a 12px spinner and disables the button. Shot and Attach screenshot while capturing.

props.name: feedback
props.description: Shown for 1200 ms after activation, then reverts. The caller owns the timer. Bulk verb Copy shows Copied with check.

props.name: error
props.description: When set: red text and error glyph, and the string as the tooltip. Attach screenshot error.

props.name: active
props.description: Wash fill while a mark is on (for example the link mark in the rich-text editor). Not a toggle: no aria-pressed. Use Toggle when the control itself switches state.

props.name: tabbable
props.description: Default true. false removes the button from the Tab order (capture-bar Clear draft and Attach screenshot).

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches to the container width (Reset all settings).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Muted, no pointer events, not focusable. Filter panel reset while no filter is active; move with no other lists goes to MenuButton.

props.name: type
props.description: Defaults to 'button'.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders the child as the button (Radix Slot). Used to compose DropdownMenu and Select triggers.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Activation handler.

props.name: surface
props.description: Use media over photos and the lightbox.

props.name: reveal
props.description: Default always. row: opacity 0 until the parent row is hovered, has keyboard focus within it, or is selected.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Per-use icon size, not folded into a size token. Defaults by size: sm 14, default 16, lg 16, footer 14, xl 19 (17 on media), step 26. Catalogue per-use values: Delete list tab 15; New list 18; New task 18; Search options 15; Clear search (search field) 15; Clear search (settings sidebar) 14; Close split view 16; Split view and Preview panel toggles 19; Row more menu 17; Sort and filter 14; Close preview panel 16; Discard draft 16; Rename task title 15; Copy task 15; Delete task 15; Delete note 14; Settings 19; Swap panes 19; Rename project 16; Delete project 16; Clear selection 16; Open task alone 13; Close filter panel 16; Clear section unrecorded (16 assumed); day steppers 14; Dismiss toast 14; Restore 16; Delete permanently 16; Roll another name 16; lightbox bar 17 (open externally, reveal in Finder, rename attachment, remove attachment, close); lightbox steps 26; Discard changes 19; Reset hotkey to default 15; Discard group changes unrecorded (16 assumed).

props.name: iconWeight
props.description: Stroke weight per use. Default 300. New task 400; Delete list tab 500 (catalogue).

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius override. Default from size (4.375px for sm, default, lg, footer; 7px for xl). New list passes 5.25px (catalogue className override rounded-md, line 197).

props.name: pressed
props.description: Toggle state. Sets aria-pressed and the filled look. Used by the Split view toggle (vertical_split when off; label Split view, becoming Close split view when on) and the Preview panel toggle (right_panel_open when off; label Show preview panel, becoming Hide preview panel when on).

props.name: pressedIcon
props.description: Glyph when pressed. The Preview panel toggle swaps to right_panel_close.

props.name: haspopup
props.description: Sets aria-haspopup for buttons that open a menu or panel (Row more menu, Search options, depending on its target).

props.name: keepFocusOnPress
props.description: Pointer only: prevents the mousedown default so a focused text field keeps focus. Used by Search options, Discard draft and Roll another name.

props.name: focusable
props.description: False sets tabIndex -1. Roll another name is false in the reference; this design keeps the recorded value until confirmed (see open).

props.name: retainFocus
props.description: Prevents mousedown from taking focus so the draft title textarea does not blur (draft start row).

props.name: children
props.description: Label text.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Default true. Ellipsis when the label is wider than the box.

props.name: mono
props.description: Monospace 11.5px/17.25px for paths.

props.name: block
props.description: Full-row hint style: left aligned, padded (px 3, py 2).

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown as a muted dash when the value is null (path).

props.name: description
props.description: Tooltip text (the reference title, for example Copy a file into this task).

states: hover (ghost and text: wash-2 fill or text to strong; filled variants: darker fill)
pressed (no aria-pressed; use Toggle for pressed state)
feedback (label and icon swapped for 1200 ms)
hover (ghost: wash; filled on media: white 20 percent fill; tone danger: danger text, or solid danger fill with white glyph on media)
pressed (aria-pressed true, filled look; toggles only)
open (aria-expanded true while the menu or panel it opens is shown)
revealed (row hover, keyboard focus within the row, or row selected)
swapped icon (caller-driven: Copy task shows check for 1200 ms)
default (white fill oklch 1 0 0 light; oklch 0.288 0.006 260 dark for lg)
keyboard: Enter and Space activate. Tab reaches it in DOM order unless tabbable is false. Escape is not handled here (a dialog's Escape cancels). No arrow-key behaviour.

platform: Same widget and look on both. Title bar exists on both. Desktop-only rows (no web equivalent): Shot, Attach screenshot, Clear draft. Settings: desktop opens a new Settings window; web navigates to a settings page or in-app dialog (assumption, not in source). Lightbox open externally: desktop leaves the app for the default external app; web opens a new tab or downloads (assumption); the label should change on web. Copy a file and File: desktop copies in; web uploads (assumption). Link: A says a URL or file on both; B says URL only on web (conflict, see open). Restore all and Empty apply to the signed-in user's own trash on web (assumption; multi-user not in source).
open: (1) Toast Dismiss, about 7px from Undo, is not catalogued. Add a row, or assign it to a ghost Button default. (2) Lightbox Open externally: look and hover were not measured; primary is a guess (B). (3) Reset cancel: look not captured; outline (A, from the code default) used, B used neutral. Confirm. (4) Attach screenshot attached state: A says accent fill, B says neutral; neutral used because attached is not selection. Confirm. (5) Footer Delete, bulk Delete and Trash Empty are grey in the reference; the library renders danger tone red (bulk Delete colour not recorded). Confirm. (6) No confirmation recorded for footer or bulk delete; Trash Empty asks 'Empty Trash?'. Product must decide. (7) Clear draft and Attach screenshot are removed from the Tab order (A tabbable false, B tabIndex -1). The shortcuts become the only keyboard route; state this and record the accessibility impact. (8) Shared action specs: Note header, empty-state Add note (DashedButton) and draft Note share setAddingNote; Link header, Add a link tile (TileButton) and rich-text Add link share addLink; File header and Copy a file tile share addFile. One action spec should back each group. (9) Small sizes below 24px: sm (21px) and the folded footer sort and filter (19px, 11px label, now Toggle sm 21px and 12px) are under the WCAG 2.2 24px target minimum; spacing or a larger hit area is needed. (10) Radius: B folded 5px and 8px to the size rule; kept the catalogue's exact 5px (icon md) and 8px (outline well). Clear draft label 11px vs Attach 12px is unresolved (merged to 12px). (11) Glyph sizes: catalogue 16px (sm icon, md, Clear draft) snaps to the standard 15px (sm) and 14px (md); Clear draft keeps its 16px exception. Confirm. (12) Label scale at lg: 12px/18px (catalogue ToolbarButton lg) vs 12.5px/18.75px (B for sheet, reset and filter buttons); 12px kept as measured. (13) Link platform conflict: A says a URL or file on both; B says URL only on web. Unresolved. (14) Catalogue row count is 95 against a source count of 96; one row may be missing between rows 37 and 52, so the footer and grid may be incomplete. (15) Footer Sort and filter is a Toggle, not a Button (see Toggle).

folded.name: IconButton
folded.how: Icon-only form becomes Button size=icon (the icon and shape form). Surface, shape, tone and reveal axes become Button variant or props (B). Do not move pressed or pressedIcon, since aria-pressed belongs to Toggle, nor haspopup or expanded, since aria-haspopup belongs to MenuButton and aria-expanded to DisclosureButton (A). Button's purpose (index.txt line 4) already says it merges IconButton, but IconButton is still listed at index.txt line 26 and in widgets.json, so remove the separate entry.
folded.role: button (native button element); accessible name from label; aria-pressed on toggles; aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on menu or panel triggers
folded.keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab move focus. focusable false removes the button from the Tab order. Enter and Space activate. The tooltip opens on focus; Escape closes an open tooltip, otherwise Escape is left to the containing menu or dialog. As a DropdownMenu trigger (asChild), Enter, Space and ArrowDown open the menu (Radix behaviour). keepFocusOnPress affects the pointer only. Reveal-hidden buttons also show on keyboard focus within their row (added by this design; the catalogue records hover only). Row-level stopPropagation stays with the caller.

folded.name: DashedButton
folded.how: variant=dashed (shadcn ships dashed as a variant). Its size and width axes become Button size and width props. The measured 35px and 84px heights are kept as exact size values, not folded to 63px or 28px (A, medium confidence). Index line 15 keeps it apart only for its own job, which is a variant, not a component. Job (add-something action in an empty slot) and role (button) match.
folded.keyboard: Enter and Space activate. Normal Tab order.

folded.name: TextButton
folded.how: variant=link with no fill at rest (B, index line 75), with tone, size and hover variants. Truncate, mono, block and done become Button props. Conflict: A names this variant=text. B's variant=link is kept because it cites index line 75 precisely; the team should confirm the name. Both are role=button and trigger an action or open something inline.
folded.role: button (kind link is not used: each row opens or selects, none navigates in place)
folded.keyboard: Enter and Space activate. Normal Tab order. No arrow-key behaviour.

folded.name: TileButton
folded.how: layout=stacked (icon above label in an equal-size tile). Both proposals agree on the value. Confidence is medium (A) and lower (B), since the index says a stacked layout is not a size of Button, so the team should confirm. As a layout variant the job (entry action) and role (button) are unchanged.
folded.keyboard: Enter and Space activate. Both tiles sit in the Tab order.
